name: Persian Gulf saline overflow
scope: Northern outflow/cascading reference reach: OSW upstream truncation near 26 N, then the source-described vicinity of 25deg20N,57E and 24deg50N,56deg50E. No Arabian Sea downstream route or whole-system origin/termination.
layer: Descending Persian Gulf Water core; near 220 m neutral-buoyancy description is downstream context, not a fixed 220 m trajectory or surface-current route.
time_convention: October-November1999 GOGP99 study geography. Editorial line joins regional descriptions; not one synoptic snapshot, monthly geometry or an R13 width occupation.
source_locator: Part2 author version abstract PDF1 and regional pathways discussion printed pp4-6/PDF5-7. Source supplies approximate cascade/rejoining geography, not a digitized axis.
source_citation: Pous, S.P., Carton, X. and Lazure, P. (2004), Hydrology and circulation in the Strait of Hormuz and the Gulf of Oman: Results from the GOGP99 Experiment, parts 1 and 2, JGR Oceans 109, doi:10.1029/2003JC002145 and doi:10.1029/2003JC002146. Institutional author versions.
